doc.brief: The possible accessible relations of a [`Accessible`](xref:gtk:Accessible).
doc.md:
The possible accessible relations of a [`Accessible`](xref:gtk:Accessible).

Accessible relations can be references to other widgets,
integers or strings.

active_descendant.brief: Identifies the currently active element when focus is on a composite widget, combobox, textbox, group, or application.
active_descendant.md:
Identifies the currently active
   element when focus is on a composite widget, combobox, textbox, group,
   or application. Value type: reference

col_count.brief: Defines the total number of columns in a table, grid, or treegrid.
col_count.md:
Defines the total number of columns
   in a table, grid, or treegrid. Value type: integer

col_index.brief: Defines an element's column index or position with respect to the total number of columns within a table, grid, or treegrid.
col_index.md:
Defines an element's column index or
   position with respect to the total number of columns within a table,
   grid, or treegrid. Value type: integer

col_index_text.brief: Defines a human readable text alternative of %GTK_ACCESSIBLE_RELATION_COL_INDEX.
col_index_text.md:
Defines a human readable text
  alternative of %GTK_ACCESSIBLE_RELATION_COL_INDEX. Value type: string

col_span.brief: Defines the number of columns spanned by a cell or gridcell within a table, grid, or treegrid.
col_span.md:
Defines the number of columns spanned
  by a cell or gridcell within a table, grid, or treegrid. Value type: integer

controlled_by.brief: Identifies the element (or elements) that the current element is controlled by.
controlled_by.md:
Identifies the element (or elements) that the current
element is controlled by. Value type: reference

This relation is managed by GTK and should not be set from application code.

controls.brief: Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the current element.
controls.md:
Identifies the element (or elements) whose
   contents or presence are controlled by the current element. Value type: reference

described_by.brief: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.
described_by.md:
Identifies the element (or elements)
   that describes the object. Value type: reference

description_for.brief: Identifies the element (or elements) that are described by the current element.
description_for.md:
Identifies the element (or elements) that are described by
the current element. Value type: reference

This relation is managed by GTK and should not be set from application code.

details.brief: Identifies the element (or elements) that provide additional information related to the object.
details.md:
Identifies the element (or elements) that
   provide additional information related to the object. Value type: reference

details_for.brief: Identifies the element (or elements) for which the current element provides additional information.
details_for.md:
Identifies the element (or elements) for which the current
element provides additional information. Value type: reference

This relation is managed by GTK and should not be set from application code.

error_message.brief: Identifies the element (or elements) that provide an error message for an object.
error_message.md:
Identifies the element (or elements) that
   provide an error message for an object. Value type: reference

error_message_for.brief: Identifies the element (or elements) for which the current element provides an error message.
error_message_for.md:
Identifies the element (or elements) for which the current
element provides an error message. Value type: reference

This relation is managed by GTK and should not be set from application code.

flow_from.brief: Identifies the previous element (or elements) in an alternate reading order of content which, at the user's discretion, allows assistive technology to override the general default of reading in document source order.
flow_from.md:
Identifies the previous element (or elements) in an alternate
reading order of content which, at the user's discretion, allows
assistive technology to override the general default of reading in
document source order. Value type: reference

This relation is managed by GTK and should not be set from application code.

flow_to.brief: Identifies the next element (or elements) in an alternate reading order of content which, at the user's discretion, allows assistive technology to override the general default of reading in document source order.
flow_to.md:
Identifies the next element (or elements)
   in an alternate reading order of content which, at the user's discretion,
   allows assistive technology to override the general default of reading in
   document source order. Value type: reference

label_for.brief: Identifies the element (or elements) that are labeled by the current element.
label_for.md:
Identifies the element (or elements) that are labeled by the
current element. Value type: reference

This relation is managed by GTK and should not be set from application code.

labelled_by.brief: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.
labelled_by.md:
Identifies the element (or elements)
   that labels the current element. Value type: reference

owns.brief: Identifies an element (or elements) in order to define a visual, functional, or contextual parent/child relationship between elements where the widget hierarchy cannot be used to represent the relationship.
owns.md:
Identifies an element (or elements) in order
   to define a visual, functional, or contextual parent/child relationship
   between elements where the widget hierarchy cannot be used to represent
   the relationship. Value type: reference

pos_in_set.brief: Defines an element's number or position in the current set of listitems or treeitems.
pos_in_set.md:
Defines an element's number or position
   in the current set of listitems or treeitems. Value type: integer

row_count.brief: Defines the total number of rows in a table, grid, or treegrid.
row_count.md:
Defines the total number of rows in a table,
   grid, or treegrid. Value type: integer

row_index.brief: Defines an element's row index or position with respect to the total number of rows within a table, grid, or treegrid.
row_index.md:
Defines an element's row index or position
   with respect to the total number of rows within a table, grid, or treegrid.
   Value type: integer

row_index_text.brief: Defines a human readable text alternative of [`AccessibleRelation.ROW_INDEX`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRelation#value:ROW_INDEX).
row_index_text.md:
Defines a human readable text
   alternative of [`AccessibleRelation.ROW_INDEX`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRelation#value:ROW_INDEX). Value type: string

row_span.brief: Defines the number of rows spanned by a cell or gridcell within a table, grid, or treegrid.
row_span.md:
Defines the number of rows spanned by a
   cell or gridcell within a table, grid, or treegrid. Value type: integer

set_size.brief: Defines the number of items in the current set of listitems or treeitems.
set_size.md:
Defines the number of items in the current
   set of listitems or treeitems. Value type: integer

init_value.brief: Initializes `value` with the appropriate type for the `relation`.
init_value.md:
Initializes `value` with the appropriate type for the `relation`.

This function is mostly meant for language bindings, in conjunction
with gtk_accessible_update_relation_value().
